title: trapped in the department store
content: my mall has a very large department store inside of it, similar to a dillards if yallre familiar with that. its very bright, with a lot of white display shelving, very very clean. the ladies that work inside of it are silent, and never interact with customers. whenever i find myself in the department store, it seems almost separate from the mall, and i get lost within all the individual departments and maze of shelves and racks. there is no escaping the department store, and i always spawn directly into it, never walking inside from the rest of the mall. the only time i have ever managed to find the exit and leave, was when there was an active shooter situation. i held a baby i did not know in my arms, and scrambled out the front doors with a mass wave of confused and scared customers. has anyone else ever had any experiences like this? im curious!
